content.value_statement: Schema changes can break deployments when rollback, locking, and compatibility are missed. This skill helps plan and review backend migrations for safer database evolution.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when to create migration files for schema changes.
Guides additions, removals, and modifications of tables and columns.
Supports planning for reversible migrations and rollback paths.
Encourages separation of schema migrations from data migrations.
Helps review migration files for deployment safety and data integrity.
Covers index creation and removal considerations.
limitations: Does not execute migrations or connect to a database by itself.
Does not include framework-specific migration commands in the reviewed file.
Depends on project migration tooling and local standards.
Cannot validate production data volume, locks, or runtime behavior without project context.

use_cases.title: Plan a Table Change
use_cases.description: Prepare a reversible migration before adding, renaming, or removing database fields.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Safe Release
use_cases.description: Check migration order, compatibility, and rollback needs before a production deployment.

use_cases.title: Review Migration Risk
use_cases.description: Assess migration files for data integrity, reversibility, and schema version control.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to plan a reversible migration for adding [field] to [table]. Include rollout, rollback, and data integrity checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Schema Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to review this proposed schema change: [describe change]. Identify compatibility risks and rollback concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Zero-Downtime Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to design a zero-downtime rollout for [migration goal]. Include phased deployment steps and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Migration Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend-migrations skill to audit these migration files before release: [summarize files]. Prioritize blocking risks and required fixes.

output_examples.input: Add a nullable customer status column to the accounts table.
output: A migration plan that adds the column before application code depends on it.
A rollback note that removes the column only after dependent code is reverted.
A short checklist for defaults, indexes, and existing records.

output_examples.input: Review a migration that drops an orders column during a release.
output: A risk review that flags compatibility and rollback concerns.
A safer phased approach using deprecation, code cleanup, and delayed removal.
Questions about dependent services, reports, and data retention.

output_examples.input: Plan an index for a high-traffic user lookup.
output: An index rollout plan focused on lock risk and query performance.
Validation steps for query plans and production impact.
Rollback guidance if the index causes deployment or runtime issues.

best_practices: Create reversible migrations and document the rollback path before merge.
Separate schema changes from data backfills when either step can fail independently.
Plan destructive changes as phased releases with compatibility checks.
anti_patterns: Dropping columns in the same release that removes application references.
Combining large data rewrites with structural schema changes.
Adding indexes to large production tables without lock and performance planning.

faq.question: What migration tasks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports planning, creating, reviewing, and documenting backend database schema migrations.

faq.question: Does this skill run database commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for migration work and does not connect to databases.

faq.question: Can it help with zero-downtime deployments?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts for compatibility, rollout order, rollback planning, and deployment safety.

faq.question: Can it create framework-specific migration files?
faq.answer: It can guide file design, but exact syntax depends on the project migration tool.

faq.question: How should I use it for reviews?
faq.answer: Ask it to check reversibility, data integrity, lock risk, and release sequencing.

faq.question: Is it safe for production migration planning?
faq.answer: Use it as planning support. Always test migrations in staging before production release.
